result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but a prominent restaurant card has a broken or unloaded image, leaving a placeholder in a key content area.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a gray image placeholder icon instead of the restaurant/food image, unlike the surrounding restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image asset URL or image-loading state for this card. If loading fails, show a polished branded fallback image rather than a generic broken-image placeholder.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is visibly cut off, including its title and delivery information, which can look unintended without a clear carousel affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has clear scroll affordances (such as a partial-card treatment with adequate padding, paging indicator, or swipe hint) and avoid clipping important text too tightly.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, leaving a partial unlabeled chip visible.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear horizontal-scroll cue and spacing, or constrain/resize chips so the visible area does not end on an ambiguous partial chip.
